facts.fact: Supertrees are vertical gardens rather than a standalone New Year venue promise. Observatory access is a different attraction from simply visiting the grove at ground level.
facts.excerpt: the Supertrees present a bold new way to grow and display plants.
facts.location: Explore the Garden, description of vertical gardens.

facts.fact: The ordinary attraction page says the lights switch off11.30pm. The guide instead relies on the specific dated festive show notices and does not infer a midnight lights or fireworks programme.
facts.excerpt:
The Supertrees lights will be switched off
at 11.30pm every night.
facts.location: Opening Hours footnote; general schedule does not override dated event conditions.

facts.fact: The page’s current works advisory preserves pedestrian access to WaterfrontPromenade with a diversion, while restricting cyclists during bridge construction. The guide asks readers to use the current walking route rather than promising the shortest historic route.
facts.excerpt: Pedestrians may still access the Waterfront Promenade, with a slight diversion to their route.
facts.location: Current site advisory, Bay South–Bay East Bridge Construction from4May2026.
